svg.aria-label: Quality against footprint, with 95% confidence intervals. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget; the dotted line is the Pareto front (no model above it is both smaller and better). A point's horizontal position is weights plus its own KV cache, so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests
svg.title: Quality against footprint, with 95% confidence intervals. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget; the dotted line is the Pareto front (no model above it is both smaller and better). A point's horizontal position is weights plus its own KV cache, so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests
svg.desc: Quality against footprint, with 95% confidence intervals. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget; the dotted line is the Pareto front (no model above it is both smaller and better). A point's horizontal position is weights plus its own KV cache, so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
